block.claude_code.model.description: Runs the local Claude Code CLI with per-output instructions, persistent sessions and application-managed MCP references.
block.claude_code.title: Block name
block.claude_code.directory_placeholder: Select a directory or use the input
block.claude_code.working_directory_inpu: Use an input for the working directory
block.claude_code.directory_hint: This switch applies immediately. Turning it off removes the input and its links. A non-empty input overrides the configured directory.
block.claude_code.directory_sync_failed: Port update failed. Reopen the properties to check its state.
block.claude_code.model_hint: Choose an alias or enter an exact model ID. Access and effort support depend on your Claude account.
block.claude_code.session_hint: One session per block and blueprint instance. All outputs share it sequentially. Disabling persistence forgets the association at the next execution, not the Claude transcript.
block.claude_code.session_empty: Available after the first successful execution
block.claude_code.reset_pending: Apply to start a new session on the next execution.
block.claude_code.copy_failed: Copy unavailable. Select and copy the identifier.
block.claude_code.permissions_hint: Claude can read or modify the working directory according to these permissions. This unattended block cannot show approval dialogs. The danger option grants unrestricted tool execution.
block.claude_code.limits_hint: 240 seconds maximum for the whole activation. Authentication uses the local Claude CLI; no API key is stored in this block.
block.claude_code.instruction_hint: A non-empty selected input replaces this instruction. Other inputs are included as named data. Port order does not change the mapping.
block.claude_code.mcp_error: MCP registry unavailable. Saved selections are preserved.
block.claude_code.mcp_empty: No MCP server configured. Add one in Application Settings.
block.claude_code.mcp_hint: Only selected application references are used. URLs, headers and credentials are resolved at execution and are never stored in the blueprint.
block.claude_code.command_hint: The prompt and MCP connection parameters are intentionally omitted.
block.claude_code.apply_hint: The directory-port switch applies immediately. Apply saves the other settings.
